scope: All tracked JavaScript/CJS/MJS and newly added canonical src/tests/tools/qa code syntax and literal loader/dependency inventory; temporary untracked browser-preview copies are excluded. Every src module has a recorded focused semantic role review. Baseline design gaps are explicitly separated from their observed current resolution. Static checks are not complete branch execution, formal proof, browser rendering or measured FPS.

semanticReview.review: Reviewed pose selectors, actor surface caches, boss/copy ownership, enemy fallback gating and player/stories. Enemy hit pose exists but core nonboss damage does not set hitUntil.
semanticReview.preserve: Exact world combat positions, existing own sprites, support identities and fail-closed missing art.

exportedDataInspection.traversal: Every enumerable exported source-data field is visited once; functions are counted, not invoked by this traversal.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: Baseline nonlethal enemy hits did not emit a contact effect. Boss hits only set a short throttled hitUntil; kill effects originated at target centre. Existing effect kind hit is player damage, not enemy damage.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.resolution: Current implementation records exact successful muzzle/selected-victim impact primitives in an opt-in private WeakMap ring. Earliest relative swept contact is measured only after the real victim is selected; no disappearance inference, extra damage or serialized world field.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: Baseline basic/memory/counter shots reused one static26px own-story slash or22x9 wind arrow without distinct power treatment, compact muzzle accent or shot-linked contact feedback.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.resolution: Current own-source module keeps the original story/arrow source, adds cached restrained source tails and tip pivots, and grades existing basic/memory/counter/ego states without changing speed/damage/count.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: Legacy effects draw before bodies, so a centre-origin kill or hit could be obscured by an opaque actor.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.resolution: Current new contacts/defeat layers draw above actors/friendly shots and below hostile hazards/bullets; player hit core remains last.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: Low mode draws30FPS while core steps60Hz. A proposed draw-only observer could miss shots born and consumed between frames.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.resolution: Implemented private core success events instead of a draw-only observer or inferred disappearance. App opts in before stepping; the64-slot ring retains exact events across skipped draws and is separate for every world identity.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: Bounded hostile stamp caches, weak bullet bindings, offscreen draw skip, measured3-wide batching, low-DPR1, mobile shadow/blur removal and bounded image concurrency already exist.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.recommendation: Do not install duplicate engines/optimizers or reduce all visual quality. Measure incremental shot/contact work on actual same-state scenes.

baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.finding: This repository uses Canvas2D, not the Three.js/WebGL engine of the separate m0 project.
baselineFindingsAndCurrentResolutions.recommendation: Keep the existing Canvas2D architecture. Report CPU submission/frame observations honestly; WebGL draw-call/texture-memory counters are not directly available here.

limits: App boot intentionally not executed by this static audit; use real browser QA and existing app harness tests.
Allocation-site counts are lexical inventory, not evidence of GC events or per-frame costs.
String-built/dynamic paths and semantic outcomes require existing runtime tests and companion asset-contract audit.
This tool does not install external skills, dependencies, assets or engines and does not change product source.
